metadata.body:
# PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

Blueprint for clio-agent. The numeric work lives in plain scripts in this
repository so it can run on PBS compute nodes without an LLM:

- `agent/manifest.py`: list the DASV records on `s3://nrel-pds-porotomo/` and sample them.
- `agent/detect.py`: per-record detector (common-mode removal, 10-150 Hz band-pass, median STA/LTA).
- `agent/pbs/submit.sh`: submit the distributed detection plus aggregation job to Aurora.
- `agent/hazard.py`: anomaly z-scores, event catalogue, pumping volumes, seismogenic index, probabilities.

The experts orchestrate those scripts, inspect files, and explain results. They
never make up numbers. Every figure they report comes from `summary.json` or a
tool result.

Install by linking this directory into `~/.config/clio-agent/agent-blueprints/`.

agent_blueprint.name: PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

session.title: porotomo-induced-seismicity: Report the headline results of the agent

answer:
Headline results — agent run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (Run ID: run_20261115T155359Z_s20; summary.json generated 2026-11-15T16:02:33+00:00, md5 914f4dd3ff3b59ae6239c3461e03e5da; original PBS job 9092130.aurora-pbs). Read-only report: no PBS jobs submitted, no hazard.py/detection code run, nothing in the run directory modified.

RECORDS
- Records analysed: 759 (all status "ok"), selected from a manifest of 15,164 total records with stride 20 (~every 20th record, about 1 per 10 min), covering 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z — i.e. only ~3.31% of the total time was sampled (mean ~2004 ms per record). The first detection pass had 753 ok + 6 download_failed; the 6 were retried (retry_manifest.txt) and recovered, giving the final 759 ok.
- Anomalous records: 57 (z_threshold = 5.0; top zmax = 30.92 at 2016-03-23T20:50:17Z, driver max_sta_lta).
- DAS detections: 62 events across 53 records; n_scaled_to_full_time = 1870.77; relative b (Aki MLE) = 0.9849, mc_relative = -0.849, n_above_mc = 34.

SEISMOGENIC INDEX Sigma (exact, from summary.json)
- b = 1.0 (catalog-based): Sigma = -5.448901270028832
- b = 0.73 (catalog-based): Sigma = -5.3193012700288325
- b = 0.65 (catalog-based): Sigma = -5.280901270028833
- DAS upper bound (b_used = 0.9849352475487246): Sigma = -2.698279919032152

P(Mw >= 5.5) PER YEAR at the observed rate (p_per_year_at_observed_rate."M>=5.5"), per b scenario, exact:
- b = 1.0: 0.00011982478978644906 (~1.20e-4 /yr)
- b = 0.73: 0.004921548824626587 (~4.92e-3 /yr)
- b = 0.65: 0.014735103451029574 (~1.47e-2 /yr)
- DAS-based upper bound (b_used = 0.9849352475487246): 0.07842182774171746 (~7.84e-2 /yr)

CALIBRATED vs UPPER BOUND
- CALIBRATED: the catalog-based probabilities ("hazard_catalog_based", source "GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016", n = 5 events, mc = -0.48, mag_max = 0.07, all magtype ML — calibrated local magnitudes). These are the calibrated LBNL-catalogue numbers: Sigma(b=1.0) = -5.449, Sigma(b=0.73) = -5.319, Sigma(b=0.65) = -5.281, with P(Mw>=5.5)/yr of 1.20e-4, 4.92e-3, and 1.47e-2 respectively.
- UPPER BOUND: the DAS-based value, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842182774171746 (~7.8e-2/yr) with Sigma = -2.698279919032152, is a DAS-based UPPER BOUND with UNCALIBRATED magnitudes: it treats every DAS detection as an event at/above the catalogue minimum magnitude (over-counting) and uses relative (not calibrated ML) magnitudes, with b_used = 0.9849 from a DAS relative-magnitude Aki MLE. Note: interpretation.md's "Calibration note" mislabels the DAS bound as "the calibrated, data-driven hazard estimate" — the file's own reviewer note flags this as an error; the authoritative labelling per summary.json field names is catalog-based = calibrated, DAS = upper bound.

ASSUMPTIONS
- Probabilities use the Shapiro et al. (2021) Eq. 5 form P = 1 - exp(-V * 10^(Sigma - b*M)).
- Stride-20 sampling covers only ~3.3% of the deployment time, so rates are scaled from the observed (sampled) rate.
- Catalog-based probabilities rest on a very small local catalog (5 LBNL/NCEDC March 2016 events, ML) plus the assumed b values; the DAS bound extrapolates relative magnitudes and over-counts detections.
- Pohang cross-check (context): sigma needed at Brady for 1% Mw>=5.5 over the observed volume = -2.166 (b=1.0), -3.651 (b=0.73), -4.091 (b=0.65); Pohang reference sigma range [-2.0, -1.0], mainshock Mw 5.5, worst-case reported probabilities [0.15, 0.17], v_fig3c = 5850 m^3, total injected = 12,800 m^3.

Evidence handles: summary.json (279 lines), anomalies.csv, events.csv, detect/detect_rank0000.jsonl … detect_rank0047.jsonl (48 files) + detect_retry_login.jsonl, detect.log, hazard_rerun.log, manifest.log, manifest.txt, retry_manifest.txt, jobs.txt, interpretation.md, hourly.csv, fig_mfd.png, fig_timeseries.png — all under /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20.
